text: In 1987, North Korea started building what was meant to be the tallest hotel in the world.
One hundred and five floors. Three hundred and thirty metres. Then the money ran out.

The bare concrete shell stood empty for years and was left out of official photos. In 2008, it got a shiny glass skin. Later, lights went on outside. Inside, still nothing. It has never had a single guest.
No guests, no floors, no lift.
